summary: Bug fix verification for signal-only mode cooldown issue. Bot was fully blocked every cycle with 'Trading blocked: Cooldown: ...' in signal-only mode after feedback-loop updates. Root cause: feedback losses feeding RiskGuard cooldown via record_trade() in signal-only mode. Fix confirmed: (1) config.yaml: apply_to_risk_guard=false, (2) main.py: double guard 'feedback_apply_to_risk_guard and (not self.signal_only)' prevents record_trade calls in signal-only mode.
critical_code_review_comments: config.yaml line 186: apply_to_risk_guard: false - CORRECT, prevents synthetic feedback losses from triggering RiskGuard
main.py line 988: 'if self.feedback_apply_to_risk_guard and (not self.signal_only):' - CORRECT double guard ensures record_trade never called in signal-only mode
main.py line 992: risk_guard.record_trade() is only called when BOTH conditions true (apply_to_risk_guard=True AND signal_only=False)
Fix is comprehensive: even if someone sets apply_to_risk_guard=True in config, signal_only=True will still block record_trade calls
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: Signal-only mode cooldown issue resolved. Root cause was feedback losses calling risk_guard.record_trade() in _process_signal_feedback_loop(). Fix: (1) config.yaml: apply_to_risk_guard=false (default), (2) main.py line 988: double guard 'feedback_apply_to_risk_guard and (not self.signal_only)' ensures record_trade is NEVER called in signal-only mode, even if apply_to_risk_guard is True. All iteration 21 features still working.

rca_of_the_issue.issue: Bot fully blocked every cycle with 'Trading blocked: Cooldown: ...' in signal-only mode
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: _process_signal_feedback_loop() was calling risk_guard.record_trade(pnl_proxy) for every synthetic feedback outcome (win/loss labeling). In signal-only mode, synthetic 'loss' outcomes triggered RiskGuard cooldown periods, blocking trading.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: 1. config.yaml: Set feedback_loop.apply_to_risk_guard=false (line 186). 2. main.py: Added double guard at line 988: 'if self.feedback_apply_to_risk_guard and (not self.signal_only):' - ensures record_trade never called in signal-only mode regardless of config.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: 13 targeted tests verify: config value is false, code has double guard, signal-only mode blocks record_trade calls in all scenarios
